title: Thacker Pass Water Pollution Control Permit NEV2020104 — Phase 65 Nevada lithium project delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Nevada lithium project delivery reporting pack. The project-specific water-pollution-control permit defines authorized facilities, conditions, monitoring, reporting, and compliance obligations for Thacker Pass through a stated March 11, 2027 expiration unless modified or otherwise acted upon.
key_findings: Permit NEV2020104 establishes project-specific water-pollution-control conditions and monitoring obligations.
The permit contains reporting, notification, inspection, and compliance requirements that can be checked against later records.
Its stated term and conditions do not establish construction, measured water use, compliance, production, or renewal.
why_it_matters: Which records separate land and environmental authorization, financing, construction, commissioning, compliance, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. The permit supplies a concrete, testable environmental layer between broad authorization and operating performance.
ftfn_relevance: Provides a locally captured primary permit for the Nevada shelf.
Creates named condition, monitoring, and reporting checks.
Supports dated follow-up on modification, expiration, renewal, enforcement, and operation.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
An issued permit does not prove that the facility was constructed or operated.
The permit is not evidence of measured withdrawals, discharges, compliance, or environmental impact.
Current status after the stated term must be verified from later NDEP records.
